units.source_text: 过了五六天，纪伊守把这孩子带来了。

en.t: Five or six days later, the Governor of Kii brought the boy to him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子仔细一看，相貌虽然算不得十全，却也秀丽可爱，是个上品的孩子。

en.t: When Prince Genji looked at him closely, he saw that although the boy was not perfectly handsome, he was graceful and charming, a child of refined quality.

units.source_text: 便召他进入帘内，十分宠爱他。

en.t: He summoned him inside the curtains and treated him with great affection.

units.source_text: 这孩子的小心坎里自然不胜荣幸。

en.t: In the child's young heart, this naturally felt like an overwhelming honor.

units.source_text: 源氏公子详细探问他姐姐的情况。

en.t: Prince Genji questioned him in detail about his elder sister.

units.source_text: 凡无关紧要的事，小君都回答了，只是有时羞涩不语，源氏公子也不便穷究。

en.t: Kogimi answered everything that was of no great importance, but at times he grew shy and fell silent, so Prince Genji could not well press him further.

units.source_text: 然而说了许多话，使这孩子知道他是熟悉这女子的。

en.t: Still, Genji said enough to make the child understand that he knew the woman well.

units.source_text: 小君心中隐约地想：“原来两人之间是有这等关系的！”

en.t: Kogimi vaguely thought to himself, So there was that sort of connection between the two of them.

units.source_text: 然而童心幼稚，并不深加考虑。

en.t: But his childish heart was still young, and he did not think about it deeply.

units.source_text: 有一天，源氏公子叫他送一封信给他姐姐。

en.t: One day, Prince Genji had him deliver a letter to his sister.

units.source_text: 空蝉吃惊之余，流下泪来。

en.t: Utsusemi was so startled that tears began to fall.

units.source_text: 又恐引起这孩子怀疑，不当稳便；心中却又颇想看这封信，便端起信来，遮住了脸，从头阅读。

en.t: She also feared it would be awkward if she made the child suspicious, yet inwardly she very much wanted to see the letter, so she lifted it up, hid her face behind it, and read from the beginning.

units.source_text: 这信很长，末了附诗一首：

en.t: The letter was very long, and at the end it included one poem:
